title: PostReady: PR #459 — Replace pea green with emerald sitewide
description: Colour-refresh across landing page: swaps olive/pea green (#819F4F) for the brighter emerald (#1fa463) that appears on the 'Posted to 8 platforms' button. Applied to solid fills, icon tints, gradient partners, and glow shadows sitewide. Merged Jul 9.

title: PostReady: PR #458 — Hero demo cursor clicks 'Post to all 8'
description: Adds the tap moment to the hero's animated demo: an animated MousePointer2 cursor glides in, clicks 'Post to all 8', and the button flips green — mirroring the OneTapDemo UX pattern. Makes the hero self-explanatory without a caption. Merged Jul 9.

title: PostReady: PR #457 — Faster hero demo + tighter 'gap' section copy
description: Two landing micro-polish: hero 'Post to all 8' button now flips 1 s after post assembles (was ~3.4 s dead pause); 'gap' section copy tightened for clarity. Merged Jul 9.

title: PostReady: PR #456 — Animated 'one tap → posts everywhere' demo section
description: New 'One tap. Every platform.' landing section showing the product's core workflow as live animated UI: sushi post assembled on left, real platform logos lighting up on right. No static screenshot — fully interactive animation. Merged Jul 9.

title: PostReady: PR #455 — Real post imagery in proof grid (sushi packs + Cobra shot)
description: Proof grid and 'Built for businesses' storefront now use real ZippityOne output (sushi post packs grid, Cobra Sushi restaurant shot) instead of clip-art placeholders. Makes social proof immediately credible. Merged Jul 9.

title: PostReady: PR #454 — Landing 'how it works' mockup images enlarged for legibility
description: Desktop UX fix on postready-beta landing page 'how it works' section: reduced inner frame padding (p-4/p-6 → p-3) so create-form, image+caption, and post-to-all mockup screenshots fill their cards. Widened section container from max-w-6xl to max-w-7xl for more horizontal room. Makes step illustrations legible at a glance. Merged Jul 9.

title: PostReady: PR #453 — Landing 'say it once' + marquee/hero/create-screen polish (launch prep)
description: Launch-prep landing polish: messaging tightened to 'say it once' principle across headline, hero copy, marquee, and create-screen. Removes redundant explanatory text and tightens the value prop for first-time visitors. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #451 — Landing 'how it works' mobile clarity (numbered + stacked flow)
description: Mobile UX fix on postready-beta landing page: 'how it works' section rewritten with numbered steps and stacked layout for small screens — clarifies the 3-step flow that was hard to parse on mobile. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #443 — Multi-scene stitch step bounded (no retry-loop stall)
description: Fixed destructive retry-loop stall in the multi-scene stitch step (stitchClips → fal-ai/ffmpeg-api/merge-videos). STITCH_STEP_CONFIG had retries+timeouts misconfigured — same class as the scene-render bug fixed in PR #441. Bounds stitch to prevent hang after parallel render completes. Merged Jul 8.

title: PostReady: PR #442 — Multi-scene storyboard generator + hardened single-shot guard
description: 'Write my scenes for me' storyboard generator added: users describe their video idea, AI generates a full scene breakdown. Hardened single-shot guard prevents accidental multi-scene renders for basic prompts. Merged Jul 8.
